messages.subject: help for methyl-kit use
parts:
Respected Sir,

I am working on a bisulphite sequencing project, i was trying to install the methylkit and amp-errbs pipeline, Sir my data is paired end sequence and current version of amp-errbs doesn't support paired end data and also one of its dependency is showing no active link to download, please help me to solve this problem, is there any other way to generate the inputs of the methylkit other than amp-errbs.

Kindly help

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] help for methyl-kit use
parts:
You can skip the step of adapter trimming (hoping you don't have adapter contamination), and align your data with Bismark, get a SAM output and run methylKit. This way, you don't need to use the pipeline.

Best,
Altuna
